vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts RCE via OGNL Injection
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Remote code execution in Apache Struts due to improper OGNL expression evaluation in user-supplied input.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply the latest Apache Struts security update per vendor instructions.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A local attacker can elevate privileges via a use-after-free in win32k.sys.
Pre-authentication remote code execution in FortiGate SSL-VPN due to improper bounds checking.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Update to the patched firmware version per Fortinet PSIRT advisory.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Memory corruption in Citrix ADC allowing remote attackers to crash the management plane.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply patch from Citrix bulletin CTX-2026-XXXX.
